title: Config
description: `.devset/config.toml`: the layers, and the target's word on every setting they carry.

merge.description: Merge settings; these override every layer's.

SourceSpec.description: A source as written in `config.toml`: Cargo's git-dependency fields.

rev.description: Full commit id to use; only with `git`.

path.description: The profile's directory: relative to the target, or within the repository with `git`.

MergeSpec.description: A `[merge]` table: defaults in `profile.toml`, decisions in `.devset/config.toml`.

on-conflict.description: What an update does when a file conflicts.

driver.description:
A merge program, with `%O %A %B %P` substituted.

From a profile it is only a suggestion: devset never runs a program a profile names.

OnConflict.description: What an update does when a file conflicts.

oneOf.description: Write every other file and advance the lock; conflicts wait in `.devset/conflicts/`.
Write nothing but the conflicts until every one is resolved.

Override.description: A `[files."path"]` entry in `config.toml`, overriding the providing layer's.

from.description: The layer that provides the file, when several do.

validate.description: How a merged result is checked.

oneOf.description: The profile is authoritative; local edits are drift.
Local edits are kept, and merged with the profile's.
Written once if absent; the target's from then on.

Format.description: How a file is checked after a merge: it must parse, with no duplicate keys.

oneOf.description: JSON with comments and trailing commas (JSONC), a superset of JSON.
